'''Fush LS Space in need of improvement''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 22 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi War Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassiwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi War Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Yavin 4 Massassi War Room Fush LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I have to improve this deck. Which modifications do you recommend to build it stronger?

== Strategy ==

I've put almost every rare I've got into this deck... (Yeah, that many.) It's supposed to be a space deck that could also hold it's own at a site or two. But I realize that it's not that good yet. What to buy...?
